name: adjust_flag_call_library
description: Tests bit 5 of a global byte and, when it is set, decrements that byte if it is above 47 before calling a library function at offset minus 294. When that call returns nonzero it writes fixed values to the globals and calls a second library function at offset minus 210.

name: check_library_call_status
description: Boot block entry that calls a library function at offset minus 96 from a base register and returns minus one when that function returns zero, otherwise zero. The recorded facts show the entry is called by the Kickstart strap and references the DOS library.

name: busy_wait_delay_loop
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter until it wraps past zero, spinning for the whole cycle, then returns its second parameter unchanged. It makes no calls and touches no hardware.

name: busy_wait_delay_loop
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter until it wraps past zero, spinning for the whole cycle, then returns its second parameter unchanged. It makes no calls and touches no hardware.

name: xor_decode_and_init_hardware
description: XOR-decodes a range of program memory with the byte value 115, writes fixed words to copper-list style memory locations, and sets masks that clear the interrupt enable and DMA control registers. It calls a routine to open a library, calls two further library functions at offsets minus 552 and minus 414, and closes the library at the end.

name: fill_table_with_cycling_values
description: Writes 320 consecutive long values into a table, starting at a fixed base and increasing each value by one, with the sequence wrapping back to its starting value at a fixed limit. It returns nothing and calls no other routine.

name: copy_block_to_fixed_buffer
description: Copies a block of bytes byte by byte from one region of program data into a fixed buffer, stopping when the source address reaches a fixed limit. It first copies a 32-bit value into another global and then stores the buffer address in a global variable.

name: copy_block_to_fixed_buffer
description: Copies a block of bytes byte by byte from one region of program data into a fixed buffer, stopping when the source address reaches a fixed limit. It first copies a 32-bit value into another global and then stores the buffer address in a global variable.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one with no other operation.

name: read_bit_stream_word
description: Stores the low byte of a value read from memory before A0 together with the high byte of D7 into a word at A5, then returns that value shifted right one bit with the top bit set. The shift-and-set-top-bit return is the pattern of a bit-stream reader in a decompression loop.

name: shift_bit_buffer_with_refill
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by one bit per iteration for a count taken from a 16-bit register, calling a routine to reload the buffer whenever it becomes zero. It returns nothing.

name: program_masked_blit_rectangle
description: Computes a rectangle from four coordinate parameters, waits until the blitter is idle, and programs its control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers. It then sets the modulo and destination registers from values taken from fixed lookup tables.

name: copy_rows_into_four_planes
description: Copies a block of 200 rows, each of 20 words, from a source into four destination areas offset from a global base, spreading consecutive source words across those areas. A second loop copies another 20-word run per row using the same source pointer.

name: wait_until_flag_set
description: Spins while a global byte is zero, returning once it has become nonzero. When the byte is already nonzero it returns immediately.

name: fill_paired_value_arrays_16x16
description: Runs a 16 by 16 loop that calls routines for each cell and stores a computed value into one array and double that value into a second array through its two pointers. The recorded facts list the background colour register among the touched hardware.

name: halt_after_calling_routine
description: Calls one routine and then spins in an infinite loop with no exit.

name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Does nothing but spin in an infinite loop, so it never returns.

name: update_color_palette_when_pending
description: When a global counter is nonzero, decrements it, calls a fixed sequence of routines and then writes sixteen values, each doubled from a table, to the colour register bank starting at COLOR00. The recorded facts list COLOR00 among the touched hardware.

name: add_vector_and_store
description: Adds three consecutive 16-bit components from one array into the three components of another, then calls a routine and stores its 16-bit result at the address held in A2.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without any operation.

name: pack_three_fields_into_word
description: Combines three register values into one 16-bit result, where the first value occupies the highest bit fields and the last value the lowest four bits, and returns the packed word.

name: copy_sixteen_strided_rows
description: Copies sixteen rows of words from two source regions into two destination regions, writing four values per row into each destination with fixed strides.

name: blit_rows_with_bit_shift
description: Copies sixteen rows of four words from a source into a destination. When the low four bits of the x-position are zero it copies directly; otherwise it shifts each source word by that amount and merges it into the destination under a mask, returning zero or the last computed value.

name: copy_tables_and_apply_masks
description: Copies two fixed source tables into two destination areas, then runs sixteen rows that combine words from a third table into a destination using AND masks and OR values. The routine uses fixed table addresses rather than parameters.

name: update_flag_bits_test_bit3
description: Sets bits in a word and clears bits in a byte at offsets derived from a parameter, then calls two routines. It returns zero when bit 3 of the second routine's result is set and minus one otherwise, and the recorded facts show it reads the CIA port A register.

name: swap_buffer_and_copy_frame
description: Chooses between two screen buffer addresses for double buffering based on the buffer passed in A0 and the current buffer global, then advances the chosen buffer by 4096. It copies a block of 32-bit values from the opposite buffer at a fixed offset into the chosen buffer and returns the result of a routine called beforehand.

name: set_buffer_and_copy_frame
description: Selects the screen buffer from the value in A1 and the current buffer global, falling back to a second buffer when needed, and advances it by 4096. It copies a block of 32-bit values from the opposite buffer at a fixed offset into the new buffer and returns the result of a routine called beforehand.

name: copy_rows_divided_by_eleven
description: Divides a 16-bit value by eleven to obtain a row count and remainder, then runs nested loops that copy runs of longs for each row segment. It calls six routines during the loops and returns minus one or zero depending on how the loops end.

name: copy_row_segments_loop
description: Repeatedly copies runs of longs from one table into a destination, decrementing a global row counter each pass and calling three routines between passes. It returns minus one when the counter reaches zero inside its inner loop and zero otherwise.

name: call_routine_return_minus_one
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns minus one.

name: delay_loop_after_setting_global
description: Stores 119 in a global variable and then runs a nested countdown loop that wastes time before returning. The recorded facts show the CIA port B register is touched.

name: set_global_to_255
description: Stores 255 in a global variable and returns. The recorded facts show the CIA port B register is touched, although the pseudo-code only writes the global.

name: poll_bit4_until_clear
description: Polls bit 4 of a global byte up to 256 times, calling a routine each time the bit is set, and clears two globals when the bit becomes clear or the count runs out. The recorded facts show the CIA port A register is touched.

name: step_port_bits_toward_target
description: Stores a value in a global byte with bit 2 cleared and set when the parameter's low bit is clear, then computes the difference from the parameter's even part. It repeatedly writes a byte with bit 0 set and calls a routine until that routine returns zero, with the sign of the difference choosing whether bit 1 is set. The recorded facts show the CIA port B register is touched.

name: set_bits_poll_until_zero
description: Sets the low two bits of a global byte and writes it back, calling a routine each time and repeating while the routine returns nonzero. The recorded facts show the CIA port B register is touched.

name: clear_bit1_poll_until_zero
description: Clears bit 1 of a global byte and writes it back with bit 0 set, calling a routine each time and repeating while the routine returns nonzero. The recorded facts show the CIA port B register is touched.

name: busy_wait_3000_iterations
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from 3000 to minus one, wasting time, and returns.

name: return_minus_one_status
description: Returns minus one with no other work.

name: read_disk_track_sectors
description: Clears a small table of eleven bytes, programs the disk controller's DMA pointer, length and MFM mode registers, then waits for the MFM sync word in the track data. It then reads up to ten sector entries, marking each one in the table, and returns minus one when a step fails. The recorded facts show the CIA interrupt control register is touched.

name: read_sector_headers_loop
description: Repeats a sector-processing step for a counted number of sectors, marking each processed sector in a table and returning minus one when the step fails or the sector index exceeds ten. It returns zero once every sector has been processed.

name: read_byte_with_retries
description: Calls a routine and retries it while a flag is set, up to three attempts, then returns the final byte read from a global.

name: delay_loop_from_parameter
description: Counts a loop down from a value derived from the parameter, a quarter of it minus two, wasting time, and returns.

name: combine_masked_longs
description: Returns the long at the offset plus four, ANDed with a mask, OR'd with the long at the offset ANDed with the same mask and shifted left by one bit.

name: find_sync_copy_shifted_words
description: Scans a word stream for two alternating marker words, comparing the words that follow each marker against a pair of stored patterns. When a pattern matches, it copies 8192 words into a global buffer, combining each adjacent pair with a shift amount taken from the table position, and returns zero; it returns minus one when the stream ends without a match.

name: find_sync_copy_shifted_words
description: Scans a word stream for two alternating marker words, comparing the words that follow each marker against a pair of stored patterns. When a pattern matches, it copies 8192 words into a global buffer, combining each adjacent pair with a shift amount taken from the table position, and returns zero; it returns minus one when the stream ends without a match.

name: find_sync_copy_shifted_words
description: Scans a word stream for two alternating marker words, comparing the words that follow each marker against a pair of stored patterns. When a pattern matches, it copies 8192 words into a global buffer, combining each adjacent pair with a shift amount taken from the table position, and returns zero; it returns minus one when the stream ends without a match.

name: copy_words_shifted_by_offset
description: Copies 8192 words from a source into a global buffer, combining each word with the previous one through bit shifts by an amount taken from the parameter. It returns zero.

name: merge_alternate_bit_lanes
description: For a count derived from the parameter, combines each long from one source with the matching long from a second source using a mask that selects alternate bit positions, with the second source shifted left by one bit. Results are stored into the destination block.

name: compute_bounding_box_over_list
description: Loads eight fields from a record into globals, then walks a linked list of records, tracking the smallest first and third fields and the largest second and fourth fields. It stores the two resulting pairs in globals and restores the previous list head first.

name: init_edge_record_fill_pairs
description: Stores four word parameters into the record at A3, clears a long field and fills the table after the record with pairs holding the first two parameters, one pair for each step from the third parameter to the fourth.

name: merge_span_lists_by_overlap
description: Merges two linked lists of span records by comparing their horizontal ranges and vertical bounds, writing each overlapping result span into a new list in global memory. It returns zero when either list is empty.

name: append_record_to_list_tail
description: Walks a linked list through the link field at offset 8 to its last entry and stores the second pointer there, appending it. It does nothing when either pointer is null.

name: intersect_span_lists_into_buffer
description: Intersects a list of span records with a second list, computing the overlapping horizontal and vertical ranges of each pair and writing the overlapping records into a global buffer. It returns the last record written, or null when the inputs are null or nothing overlaps.

name: copy_record_list_to_buffer
description: Copies a linked list of records into a global buffer, copying each record's header words and its following data, then links the copies together and ends the list with a null link.

name: store_pair_into_pointer
description: Stores the first parameter at the address held in A4 and stores the value in A3 into a global variable.

name: compute_bounding_box_over_list
description: Sets the global list head from A3 and, when it is nonempty, walks its linked list tracking the smallest first and third fields and the largest second and fourth fields. It stores the two resulting pairs in globals.

name: clip_and_initialize_span_record
description: Tests whether a global value lies inside a span bounded by the parameters and returns the first parameter unchanged when it does not. Otherwise it clamps the span ends into a record, zeroes two fields, calls routines to finish the record and returns zero.

name: busy_wait_16bit_count
description: Counts a 16-bit register down until it wraps past zero, wasting time, and returns.

name: step_edges_store_descending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores a long for each row into memory moving backward, holding the difference and the sum of two coordinates. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_edges_store_descending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores a long for each row into memory moving backward, holding the difference and the sum of two coordinates. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_edges_store_ascending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores a long for each row into memory moving forward, holding the difference and the sum of two coordinates. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_edges_store_ascending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores a long for each row into memory moving forward, holding the difference and the sum of two coordinates. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_edges_store_both_directions
description: Steps an edge accumulator for each row and writes the same packed endpoint long into two arrays at once, one advancing forward from the first pointer and one advancing backward from the second.

name: clip_span_to_scanline_range
description: Rejects spans whose width exceeds 768 or whose coordinates fall outside the given range, returning minus one in those cases. Otherwise it clamps the span to the range, writes its endpoints into the global record, calls routines to emit it and returns zero.

name: step_edge_pairs_forward_backward
description: Steps an edge accumulator for each row and writes two endpoint pairs for that row, one moving forward from the first pointer and one moving backward from the second, both built from the stepped position and the offset.

name: step_edges_store_ascending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores a long for each row into memory moving forward, holding the difference and the sum of two coordinates. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_edges_store_ascending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores a long for each row into memory moving forward, holding the difference and the sum of two coordinates. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_edges_store_descending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores one endpoint value per row into memory moving backward from a pointer, the value holding the offset of the stepped position. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_edges_store_descending_pairs
description: Steps an edge accumulator once per row and stores one endpoint value per row into memory moving backward from a pointer, the value holding the offset of the stepped position. It returns when the row count runs out.

name: step_accumulators_per_row
description: Loops over a row count, advancing an offset accumulator by a step on each row and stepping a second accumulator until it becomes negative. It stores nothing and returns nothing.

name: compute_vertex_span_step_edges
description: Reads the coordinates of a sequence of vertices from a data block, tracking the minimum and maximum values across them and storing vertex values into a table. It then clips the resulting range against the global bounds and, when the span is valid, writes span records and steps edges through two routines.

name: rasterize_edge_spans
description: Walks two edge lists of a shape row by row, interpolating horizontal positions with a fixed-point step and writing the resulting span coordinates into the output buffer in sequence. It returns zero when the scan completes.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without any operation.

name: dispatch_by_record_type
description: Compares a 16-bit field of the record at A0 with a value held in a global record, then calls a handler chosen by an offset table entry in the record. One handler is used when the values match and another otherwise.

name: dispatch_by_sign_flag
description: Tests whether a byte selected by the record's first field is negative, then calls one of two handlers taken from table entries in the record.

name: dispatch_by_sign_flag
description: Tests whether a byte selected by the record's first field is negative, then calls one of two handlers taken from table entries in the record, with the two branches swapped relative to its neighbour.

name: dispatch_if_within_radius
description: Checks whether the squared distance from a reference point held in fixed memory to a point in globals is within a limit stored in the record, and calls one of two handlers accordingly. The check only applies when a global identifier matches a field of the record.

name: dispatch_if_vector_length_within
description: Computes the squared length of a three-component vector built from the first three parameters and calls one of two handlers depending on whether it is within a limit passed in another register.

name: dispatch_if_squared_distance_exceeds
description: Adds a global offset to three components read from a table entry, then calls one of two handlers depending on whether the sum of their squares exceeds a limit stored in the record.

name: double_values_then_dispatch
description: Doubles three values held in globals repeatedly, up to a count taken from the record, stopping when any value would leave a fixed range. It then stores the remaining count and values back and calls a handler.

name: call_then_dispatch_handler
description: Calls one routine and then calls a second routine chosen by a table entry read from the record, with no arguments.

name: set_offsets_and_dispatch
description: Stores the sum of two record fields and an input value in a global, adds a third field to it, and then calls a handler selected by a further record field.

name: select_branch_pointer_and_dispatch
description: Selects one of two pointers embedded in the record by testing the sign of a byte at an offset, passes it to a routine, calls another routine, and then calls a handler from a table entry.

name: dispatch_handler_with_globals
description: Calls a handler selected by a table entry in the record, passing two global values as arguments.

name: offset_vector_triples_then_dispatch
description: Loops over a count taken from the record, adding three fixed offsets to each triple of words in one array and writing the results into another, then calls a handler selected by a record entry.

name: fill_sign_flags_then_dispatch
description: Writes one byte per row into a buffer, set to all ones or zero depending on whether a difference between two table entries is negative, then calls a handler selected by a record entry.

name: fill_sign_flag_bytes
description: Writes one byte per count step into a buffer, all ones when the step's value is negative and zero otherwise, then calls a handler selected by a record entry.

name: fill_constant_sign_flag_bytes
description: Writes a constant flag byte for each count step, all ones when the initial value is negative and zero otherwise, then calls a handler selected by a record entry.

name: call_pointer_then_dispatch
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored at the start of the record, then calls a second handler chosen by a table entry in the record.

name: dispatch_by_first_word_index
description: Calls a handler chosen by the 16-bit value at the start of the record, using an offset table, with no arguments.

name: dispatch_by_first_word_index
description: Calls a handler chosen by the 16-bit value at the start of the record, using an offset table, with no arguments.

name: dispatch_by_field_offset_two
description: Calls a handler selected by the 16-bit field at offset two of the record, using an offset table, with no arguments.

name: store_three_words_then_dispatch
description: Stores three word parameters at the position selected by the record's first field, then calls a handler selected by the record's second field.

name: dispatch_by_field_offset_two

name: dispatch_by_indirect_offset_field

name: dispatch_two_handlers_from_record
description: Calls a handler selected by the first word of the record and then a second handler selected by the next field, with no arguments.

name: store_word_then_dispatch
description: Stores the first 16-bit field of the record in a global variable, then calls a handler selected by the second field.

name: dispatch_by_indexed_sign
description: Tests the sign of a byte at an index from the record plus a global offset, then calls one of two handlers taken from record entries depending on the result.

name: dispatch_by_indexed_sign
description: Tests the sign of a byte at an index from the record plus a global offset, then calls one of two handlers taken from record entries depending on the result, with the branches reordered relative to its neighbour.

name: set_global_107_then_dispatch
description: Stores 107 in a global variable, then calls a handler selected by the first word of the record.

name: shift_store_triples_then_dispatch
description: Repeats over a count from the record, shifting three word values right by a global amount when it is nonzero and storing each triple at a fixed stride, then calls a handler selected by a record entry.

name: project_points_with_depth_divide
description: Translates each point by global offsets and marks it with a flag byte of minus one when its depth is 63 or less. Otherwise it scales the depth down to fit, divides the horizontal and vertical offsets by that depth and stores the projected coordinates with a zero flag.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without any operation.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without any operation.

name: dispatch_with_optional_setup
description: Tests the sign of a byte selected by the record and either uses an embedded offset to pick a handler or stores a record field in a global and calls routines, one of which runs only when a parameter is zero. It then calls a handler chosen by a table entry.

name: collect_visible_vertices_and_bounds
description: Collects the coordinates of vertices from a list, skipping any whose flag byte is negative, and stores them in a table. It tracks the minimum and maximum values, clips the range and, when valid, writes span records and steps edges through routines; it returns minus one when no vertex is visible.

name: project_point_then_dispatch
description: Adds a global offset to a depth value read from the record and, when the depth is 64 or more, divides a scaled coordinate by it with an overflow check. It then calls a handler selected by a table entry.

name: shift_word_pair_sign_extend
description: Calls one routine, then returns a 64-bit result built from two 16-bit values each shifted left by the count in D3 and paired with its sign word.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns.

name: normalize_and_scale_16bit_value
description: Scales a 16-bit value up by shifting it left by eight while it is below 256 and by four while it is below 4096, then returns it multiplied by a small power of two chosen by overflow tests.

name: project_vertex_to_screen
description: Transforms a vertex by a rotated offset using global values, computes its depth and cross-product terms, and when the depth is nonzero returns the projected screen x and y as a packed pair. It returns minus one otherwise and calls five routines.

name: dispatch_by_depth_threshold
description: Compares a depth value, formed from a global offset and a record field, against 64 and calls a routine chosen by the result. It then calls a handler from a table entry.

name: dispatch_by_depth_threshold_store
description: Compares a depth value against 64 and either clears or stores a global in a per-object field, depending on the result, before calling a handler selected from a table.

name: dispatch_by_first_word_index
description: Calls a handler chosen by the 16-bit value at the start of the record, using an offset table, with no arguments.

name: store_argument_then_dispatch
description: Stores the 32-bit stack argument in a global variable, then calls a handler chosen by the first word of the record.

name: dispatch_by_first_word_index
description: Calls a handler chosen by the 16-bit value at the start of the record, using an offset table, with no arguments.

name: call_if_field_then_dispatch
description: Calls a routine when a 32-bit field of the object referenced by the record's first word is nonzero, then calls a handler selected by a table entry.

name: store_call_result_then_dispatch
description: Calls a routine and stores its 32-bit result in a field of the object referenced by the record's first word, then calls a handler selected by a table entry.

name: copy_object_fields_then_dispatch
description: Copies several 16-bit fields and constants from an object into globals, then calls a handler reached through a pointer chain stored in that object.

name: clear_globals_then_dispatch
description: Clears two global variables, then calls a handler selected by the first word of the record.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Computes an integer square root of a 32-bit parameter with a sixteen-step bit-by-bit method, leaving the result in a register.

name: build_rotation_matrix_from_angles
description: Looks up sine and cosine values from two tables for three angles stored in a structure, then writes nine words of a rotation matrix from products of those values.
